caption: "lady gaga baby name" — 500,000+ searches in 24 hours. Swipe for 10 things most people don't know about pop's best-kept secret of 2026.

Why: on September 17 TMZ published a birth certificate. Lady Gaga and Michael Polansky's first child is a girl, Rose Bean Polansky, born June 9 in Los Angeles. The world only learned a baby existed on September 12, when photos surfaced.

What most people don't know: Gaga never announced a pregnancy and has not said how the baby arrived. The rose matches the tattoo down her spine from A Star Is Born. The baby carries neither of her names.
Very simply put: pop's most photographed star kept a baby secret for 95 days.
